# googleworkspace_users (Data Source)

Lists every user in the Workspace account, optionally filtered by an Admin SDK search query. Compare it against the users you manage to find accounts created outside of code.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_users" "all" {}

# Find accounts that exist in Workspace but are not managed in code.
locals {
  managed_ids = [for u in googleworkspace_user.this : u.id]
  unmanaged   = [for u in data.googleworkspace_users.all.users : u.primary_email if !contains(local.managed_ids, u.id)]
}

data "googleworkspace_users" "board" {
  query = "orgUnitPath='/Board' isSuspended=false"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `query` (String) Admin SDK [user search query](https://developers.google.com/admin-sdk/directory/v1/guides/search-users), e.g. `orgUnitPath='/Board'` or `isSuspended=false`. Omit to list every user.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) Matching users, ordered by primary email. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the account is archived.
- `creation_time` (String) When the account was created (RFC 3339).
- `family_name` (String) Last name.
- `given_name` (String) First name.
- `id` (String) Immutable user ID.
- `include_in_global_address_list` (Boolean) Whether the user appears in the global address list.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a super admin.
- `last_login_time` (String) Last sign-in time (RFC 3339). `1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z` means never.
- `org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the user's organizational unit.
- `primary_email` (String) Primary email address.
- `recovery_email` (String) Recovery email address, or null.
- `recovery_phone` (String) Recovery phone number (E.164), or null.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the account is suspended.
